title: Anomalous craft show interest in White Sands and Los Alamos
place_text: White Sands and Los Alamos National Laboratory, New Mexico

tellings.quote: more to say about the general interest displayed in White Sands and nearby Los Alamos National Laboratory by uh by uh anomalous technologies.

plain: Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official who calls himself a whistleblower, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that unexplained craft have shown a particular interest in White Sands, a military test range in New Mexico, and the nearby Los Alamos National Laboratory, a major US weapons research site. He hints that he has more to say about it, the point being that whatever these craft are seem drawn to sensitive military places.
